game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Andrewiffrig
quote: Pretty amazing game. I had pretty low expectations going into this since I never played a splatoon game before and am easily taken back by how fun it has been. The progression is super addicting and the raids are extremely fun and challenging especially after getting new upgrades and trinkets to mess with. The platforming is extremely fluid too once you get used to it. Went into this expecting a solid 7 and am blown away. A must cop if you’re looking for a new game that will actually challenge you.
